outcome: incidence of large for gestational age (LGA) infants
cohort: 480 pregnant women at risk for gestational diabetes mellitus, with 160 having a false positive GCT and 320 having a normal GCT result.
finding: The incidence of LGA was comparable between women with false positive and normal GCT results, but pre-pregnancy underweight reduced the risk of LGA, while second trimester weight gain >7 kg increased it.
